description: three date forms: (R1) bare year/month, where year's own iso-8601-date attribute ("2001-11") is preferred over reconstructing from the separate month name "Nov"; (R2) a <date> wrapper whose own iso-8601-date attribute ("1988") is used directly; (R3) an unparseable <date> (only a <season>, no year) which cannot be resolved unambiguously and is demoted to a misc field instead of being dropped or guessed at
